meta.name: Fall Vibes
meta.description:
Embark on a leaf-peeping journey from the comfort of your home with this magical channel full of golden leaves and foliage. Grab a Pumpkin Spice Latte and settle in!

Shows: Fall in the Netherlands, Autumn Escape Leaves, Autumn Escape With Ambient Music, Enchanting Autumn, Magnificent Autumn
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
